value.hook: Before reviewing canary model sources, OMP role switches or native-first fallbacks
value.title: Native accounting facts are not active model observations

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Unisphere's `model.current` is the latest completed non-synthetic main-call model, not an unconditional active-runtime observation. At pinned revision 0370cabb, OMP's `last_model_switch` only tracks absent/default roles. OMP 18.16 changes the actual active model for named role selection, temporary selection, fallback and prewalk too. Do not equate `pending_switch=None` with proof that no active switch occurred. Source-tail completeness is separate: an unterminated record can leave the old model known while `source.pending_tail_bytes>0`.

When reviewing a native-first/fallback-only design, trace eager fallible work before the native read. In #306, `observe_bind` still resolves the OMP footer catalog and can fail before native status is consulted. Current display-name collisions are real; an installed catalog read had 54 collision groups, including GPT-6.1 Sol across three providers. Safe ambiguity refusal is correct, but it belongs only on the fallback path when native evidence is eligible.

Round-1 proof at be097a697256ffad0ad1a933706f0650342180f1: isolated pinned-SDK cold/warm role-switch replay, next-call clearing controls, exact-source parser controls and four caught source mutants; exact-head successful-job JUnit artifact 14685057196 contained 2,731 testcases with no failures/errors. C25 still keeps dependency-free review worktrees CI-only for TS; local compiled probes used existing dependency artifacts and private session outputs, not Cargo targets or live working seats.

Magic wand: a table-driven native-record canary contract that includes every active-switch role and native-valid/catalog-failing observation ordering. Difficulty: two cached Rust feature closures can name the same source revision but use incompatible crate identities; match the `.fingerprint` dependency hashes instead of selecting the first rlib.
